name: Biramitrapur–Rajgangpur National Highway
significance: NH 143H is a branch of NH 143. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Biramitrapur to Rajgangpur, and it meets NH 143 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 143 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running PurunapaniRange to Gumla
